subject: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Acme Health SOC2 Team <soc2@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request — SCIM deltas and SAML samples

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 audit next month we need a small set of artifacts so the auditor can validate provisioning and authentication controls. Would you be able to provide the following by end of day Friday?

- A 24-hour sample of SCIM provisioning delta records (create/update/deactivate) — CSV or JSON.
- A handful (3–5) of SAML assertion samples with timestamps and raw assertion XML (redact PII if needed).
- A current RBAC role snapshot showing roles, role-membership, and any service-account bindings.

If you expect any of these to require more time, a staged delivery is fine — just let us know planned ETA. Also, please include where these logs were exported from (region, system) and any filtering applied.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Senior IT Auditor — Acme Health
claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com

(attachment: auditor_request_form.pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — SCIM deltas and SAML samples

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Jonas (platform infra) and Marcus (identity ops) to pull the extracts and confirm redaction rules. We can do a staged delivery: SCIM deltas + RBAC snapshot by Thursday EOD, SAML assertion samples by Friday EOD.

A couple quick notes:
- We will redact email addresses in any sample assertions if requested; otherwise we can provide raw values in a secured transfer.
- SCIM deltas will be exported from our provisioning service in us-west-2; file will include event_type, timestamp, actor_id, target_id, and the changed attributes.

I will send a Drive link and secure transfer instructions when files are ready.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — SCIM deltas and SAML samples

Evelyn / Marcus —

I pulled a 24-hour SCIM delta window for 2026-04-13 (UTC) and prepared a CSV with the following columns: event_id, event_type, timestamp_utc, actor_id, target_id, attributes_changed. Attached a redacted sample (scim_delta_sample_20260414.csv).

RBAC snapshot exported from our identity database (roles -> member list) and flattened to CSV (rbac_role_snapshot_20260415.csv). Note: service-account bindings appear under role 'svc/automation' — we've included the service-account IDs but not keys.

For SAML assertions: we can extract raw assertion XMLs but must ensure we do not leak user passwords or MFA tokens (none are in the assertion). I prepared three sanitized samples where we pseudonymized user principal names; full raw assertions can be shared under a secure transfer if your auditor requires them. Attached saml_assertion_samples_20260414.txt (three assertions).

I also added a short README in the Drive link explaining fields and redaction steps.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Platform Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
(attachments: scim_delta_sample_20260414.csv, rbac_role_snapshot_20260415.csv, saml_assertion_samples_20260414.txt)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — SCIM deltas and SAML samples

Claire —

Delivering the artifacts as discussed. Files are uploaded to a shared Drive folder with viewer-only access for your audit team: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-acme-soc2-evidence. Attached here are the sample files and a one-page README describing the export time window and redaction procedures.

Attachments included:
- scim_delta_sample_20260414.csv (24-hour delta export, us-west-2, columns: event_id,event_type,timestamp_utc,actor_id,target_id,attributes_changed)
- rbac_role_snapshot_20260415.csv (role,member_id,member_type,service_account_flag)
- saml_assertion_samples_20260414.txt (3 sanitized assertions; full raw assertions available via secure SFTP on request)
- README_scim_saml_rbac.txt (notes on filters and redaction)

If your auditor needs the raw assertion XMLs without pseudonymization we can place them on an SFTP endpoint under an NDA for access control review. Otherwise let us know if the artifacts above satisfy the immediate need.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: README_scim_saml_rbac.txt)
